_comment: Model pin policy read by hooks/lib/model-pin.py (spawn-ledger agent.spawn hook). Category entries are EMPTY on purpose: empty = use "default". A spawner picks a category with a line `MODEL-CATEGORY: <name>` (or `[category:<name>]`) in the prompt/description. Named agents ignore this file: their frontmatter model: wins. exec_cap: max Execs running per ROOT PD across its whole tree (coords, mini-coords, direct Execs; coords never count); chain with no PD ancestor is exempt, unresolvable chain fails open. Kill switches: MODEL_PIN_OFF=1 | state/model-pin.off | .hook-profile=minimal (everything); SPAWN_CAP_OFF=1 | state/spawn-cap.off (cap only).
